public_rationale: The full-draw condition did not occur. At the end of September 2025, original DDTL 2.0 had approximately $5.0 billion outstanding, no principal repayments and no remaining borrowing capacity. The additional DDTL 2.1 tranche was separately identified. Zitron's confidence that the original remaining capacity would be drawn was not borne out. Under the conditional-forecast rule, however, the $1.52 billion interest scenario is not scored as false merely because its antecedent failed.
limitations: This claim bundles two propositions. A separately registered claim limited to the full-draw prediction would be contradicted by e5.
The draw-window deadline does not supply a definite year for measuring the hypothetical annual interest burden.

our_interpretation: The main financial projection is conditional on drawing all of the original DDTL 2.0 facility's remaining capacity.
The confidence statement also predicts that this antecedent will occur; its factual result is reported separately from the conditional cost scenario.
The surrounding heading identifies the projected annual amount as interest, although the calculation and the phrase excluding accrued interest are unclear.
The original draw window ends in June 2025, extendable by three months, so September 30, 2025 is the latest deadline supplied by the context.
A later separately identified tranche does not count as drawing the original facility's remaining capacity.
criteria.support_condition: First establish that the original $7.6 billion facility was fully drawn within its draw window. Then establish that the resulting contractual annual interest burden could reach approximately $1.52 billion under the specified terms.
criteria.contradiction_condition: If the full-draw antecedent occurred, contractual terms or complete payment evidence must rule out the stated annual interest scenario. If the antecedent did not occur, do not score the conditional scenario as false.
